# UEFI and flash-image fixtures

Synthetic fixtures for `tests/uefi.rs` and `web/tests/uefi.test.mjs`.
`generate.py` rebuilds them all from the documented wire layouts (UEFI PI
1.8 Vol. 1 chapter 15 and Vol. 3 chapters 2-3, EDK2 `edk2-stable202408`
headers, coreboot and flashrom flash descriptor definitions); it does not
call the parser under test. Nothing here is vendor firmware.

## Contents

| File | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `pe32-sections.bin` | An FFS section stream: a PE32 section holding a minimal PE32+ image for x86-64 (`Machine` 0x8664, one `.text` section of 44 B at RVA and file offset 0x180), then a `USER_INTERFACE` section naming it `LzmaDxe` |
| `pe32-sections.bin.lzma` | That stream as an LZMA-alone stream (properties `0x5D`, 64 KiB dictionary). `xz` writes the decoded size as unknown and ends the stream with an end marker; the generator then stores the real size (452) in the size field, as EDK2 `LzmaCompress` records it |
| `pe32-sections.bin.x86.lzma` | The stream x86 BCJ-filtered and LZMA1-compressed by `xz`, with a 13-byte LZMA-alone header (`0x5D`, 64 KiB, size 452) prepended: the payload of an EDK2 LZMA F86 section. The generator checks that its port of the LZMA SDK `x86_Convert` decoder (state 0, start offset 0) undoes `xz`'s filter |
| `pe32-sections.bin.br` | The stream as a Brotli stream (without the 16-byte EDK2 size prefix, which the tests add) |
| `sample.fd` | A 4 KiB `FFSv2` firmware volume, revision 2, erase polarity 1, one 4 KiB block; an extended header at 0x48 with the name `5A1E7E57-0000-4000-8000-0000000000A0` and a used-size entry; files from 0x68: an x86-64 PE32 driver (`X64Driver`, data checksum), an AArch64 PE32 driver (`Aa64Driver`, fixed checksum 0xAA), an x86-64 TE PEIM (`TePeim`), a 16-byte pad file, and a driver whose only section is an LZMA GUID-defined section (`DataOffset` 0x18, `PROCESSING_REQUIRED`) holding `pe32-sections.bin.lzma` |
| `flash.bin` | A 20 KiB flash image: 16 B of 0xFF, `FLVALSIG` at 0x10, `FLMAP0` 0x04040003 (FCBA 0x30, FRBA 0x40, NR 4) and `FLMAP1` 0x10100208 (FMBA 0x80, FPSBA 0x100); regions Descriptor 0x0-0xFFF, GbE 0x1000-0x1FFF (synthetic bytes), ME 0x2000-0x2FFF (repeated ASCII text, not firmware) and BIOS 0x3000-0x4FFF with `sample.fd` at its top (0x4000); unused registers hold 0x00007FFF |

The code bytes are synthetic: x86-64 `push rbp; mov rbp, rsp; call +0x10;
pop rbp; ret` four times, and AArch64 `nop; nop; ret`. The images are not
runnable firmware.

## Generator and commands

Generated on 2026-10-12 and regenerated byte-identically on 2026-10-13,
macOS AArch64, Python 3.14.7, XZ Utils 5.8.2 (`xz`), brotli 1.2.0:

```sh
tests/fixtures/uefi/generate.py --out tests/fixtures/uefi
```

The script runs these encoders on `pe32-sections.bin`:

| Output | Command |
| --- | --- |
| `pe32-sections.bin.lzma` | `xz --format=lzma --lzma1=preset=6,dict=64KiB -c`, then the size field at offset 5 is set |
| `pe32-sections.bin.x86.lzma` | `xz --format=raw --x86 --lzma1=preset=6,lc=3,lp=0,pb=2,dict=64KiB -c`, with the LZMA-alone header prepended |
| `pe32-sections.bin.br` | `brotli -c -q 9` |

(`efi_literal_stream` in `tests/uefi.rs` and the encoder in the unit tests
of `src/formats/compressed/efi.rs`), because EDK2 BaseTools
(`TianoCompress`, `GenSec`) were not installed.
